title: The Night Shift Rules
youtube_title: My Night Shift Came With 3 Rules. I Broke None. #shorts #scarystories
caption: Three rules for the night shift. I followed every one. So who wrote them? 😨 Follow for a new scary story every day.
style: dark cinematic digital painting, eerie moonlight, deep shadows, muted palette, horror movie still

scenes.text: My first night shift at a highway gas station came with three rules, and the last one was underlined twice.
scenes.image_prompt: lonely highway gas station at night, harsh fluorescent canopy lights, dark pine forest behind it

scenes.text: Rule one. If the pumps turn on by themselves, don't look at them. Rule two. Never sell anything after three a.m.
scenes.image_prompt: handwritten note card taped beside an old cash register, dim store counter at night

scenes.text: Rule three. If your manager comes back before sunrise, do not unlock the door.
scenes.image_prompt: glass front door of a convenience store at night, deadbolt locked, darkness outside

scenes.text: At two fifty, pump four lit up. Nobody was out there. I stared at the register until it clicked off.
scenes.image_prompt: single gas pump glowing in an empty lot at night, fog drifting under the canopy lights

scenes.text: At three twelve, someone knocked on the glass. It was my manager, smiling, jingling his keys.
scenes.image_prompt: dark silhouette of a man standing outside a store glass door at night, keys in hand, face in shadow

scenes.text: He said he forgot his wallet. He said it was freezing. He kept saying my name, over and over, without blinking.
scenes.image_prompt: hand pressed flat against a fogged glass door from outside, fluorescent light, night

scenes.text: I didn't open the door. Eventually he backed away, still smiling, into the trees.
scenes.image_prompt: a distant figure walking backwards into a dark pine forest at the edge of a parking lot

scenes.text: At sunrise my real manager pulled in. I showed him the card. He went pale. He's never written any rules. And the handwriting was mine.
scenes.image_prompt: gas station at dawn, pale morning light, a handwritten note card lying on the counter, unsettling
